status: Forward repair protocol after inspection of legacy results; not preregistration

diabetes_primary.otherwise: missing; exclude from complete-outcome joint study
diabetes_primary.interpretation: Reported diabetes or single-measurement elevated HbA1c research phenotype; not confirmed clinical diagnosis or specifically type 2 diabetes
diabetes_primary.borderline: DIQ010=3 with HbA1c below threshold is diabetes-negative, not metabolically normal; strict yes/no-only sensitivity is provided
diabetes_primary.glucose: Excluded from primary definition for uniform non-fasting ascertainment; measured-glucose composite and fully observed-component sensitivity are retained with fasting limitations

cvd_primary.otherwise: missing; never infer absence from an unanswered component
cvd_primary.interpretation: Self-reported history of heart failure, coronary heart disease, angina, heart attack or stroke

obesity_secondary: Measured BMXBMI >= 30; missing or nonpositive BMI is unknown; exploratory outcome
selection: Rebuild from available merged raw data; retain existing measured HbA1c/HDL/total cholesterol, reliable complete recall and fixed plausibility rules; require complete harmonized outcomes

split.procedure: Reserve calibration with test_size=0.15; reserve validation from remainder with test_size=0.15/0.85; sklearn train_test_split, seed=42 in both calls
split.role_training: Fit preprocessing and all model parameters; any inner tuning folds must fit their own preprocessors
split.role_validation: Hyperparameter selection and early stopping only
split.role_calibration: Fit prespecified probability recalibration after model selection; not training or early stopping
split.role_temporal: Final evaluation on already-inspected historical temporal period; no tuning/calibration
split.thresholds: No new clinical threshold selected in this task; define action and development-only selection rule before comparison

preprocessing: Reuse named-feature transformations; fit medians, modes, skew selection, clipping and scaling solely on new training partition
production: Separate research artifacts only; existing checkpoint is incompatible with refitted preprocessing and must not be paired with it
limitations: Original upstream development assembly file is absent; rebuilding begins at the available merged raw file
Unweighted selected analytic sample; survey weighting and cross-cycle assay harmonization remain separate audits
Current complete-outcome, complete-recall and measured-laboratory requirements introduce selection
Medication-based sensitivity and pregnancy applicability require additional review
This protocol has not been selected based on new model performance
